title: Solution profile frontmatter
description: The frontmatter of .sdlc/solution.md. Facts an interrogation needs that are not rules. There is no baseline field: constraints govern the change, never code that predates adoption.

adopted_at.description: The HEAD sha at adoption. Marks what predates governance; required when origin is adopted.

allOf.description: An adopted solution must say what it was adopted at, or nothing distinguishes pre-existing code.
